name: Do I need to replace all window balances if only one is broken?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to replace all window balances if only one is broken?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is not always necessary to replace all window balances if only one is broken. Often, only the faulty balance needs to be replaced to restore the window's function. However, if your windows are older and balances are failing sequentially, it might be more cost-effective in the long run to proactively replace balances in windows showing similar wear. A professional assessment can help determine the overall condition of your window balances and recommend the most practical approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: You don't always need to replace all balances if only one is broken. Consider replacing others if windows are old and showing similar wear, after a professional assessment.
